Need Adventure level 10, Trade level 40, Battle level 10, and a combined level total of 80 to change into job. Costs 500k to change into it with card. The quest to get it is called "Casting workshop administrator troubles" from the Cape Town Business Mediator. Needs R3 Navigation, R5 Management, and R3 Arms to pull it (I didn't have Arms myself, but I was able to leech it from another fleet member who had it and got quest after about using 7-8 QMPS. Not sure if you can do this with Navigation and Management though). Deliver 200 Chrome Ore to the Casting supervisor guy in Manchester in the factory.

comments.author: Jebi
comments.body: The "Master of Steam" title reduces coal fuel consumption by 1/3. During industrial revolution (IR), it reduces fuel consumption by 1 per day (since the normal rate of consumption is 3 coal fuel per day). Outside the IR period, the title reduces coal fuel consumption by 6 (since the normal rate of consumption is 18 coal fuel per day). To get to 1 fuel consumption per day during IR, you need both (1) "Master of Steam" title and (2) R15 management.
